text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...I need to make up my mind soon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The message that arrived on my smartphone was from <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems they're planning to
"hold voluntary training among the members."
After checking the details, I give them my approval.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the first "Representative Exchange Match,"
a bond among comrades began to blossom—not only between the Trainers, but between the Umamusume as well.
choice_data_list: —We're going to aim for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe together.
—Together, we're aiming for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The wall we must overcome is high. That is precisely why everyone must work together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: [Sender: Satake Mei]

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "Sorry to interrupt when you're busy. There is something I need to tell you all once again."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "After the second Representative Exchange Race, I will select four of you to represent Japan."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...These four are the ones running in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Only four people?
Out of all of us...?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You were prepared for this, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is the pinnacle of racing. It's not just Japan—contenders from all over the world are aiming for the top."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Squeezing into the starting lineup ain't easy either.
We should focus on quality over quantity.
choice_data_list: ...That's why we're entering an Uma Musume who can win.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
B-But! Even without narrowing it down to just the elite,
until race registration, everyone here could—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There's no way an Umamusume who wasn't chosen here
could ever take the title of number one in the world.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...We ain't going there
just to make memories.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even if we cooperate as a team,
it's so that we can become stronger ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even if you've grown attached to them,
don't bring that into the race.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me, Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"The announcement is scheduled immediately following
the conclusion of Race 2 of the Representative Exchange Matches."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Even if someone isn't chosen as a representative, I will arrange it so that anyone who wishes can accompany us to France.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, when selecting Japan's "representatives,"
we plan to take into account their running up through the exchange meet itself.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...I want you to pour all your strength into it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Dozens of Umamusume
are participating in 'Project L'Arc.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They are <chrname>'s companions.
Sharing the same ambition, dividing joys and sorrows,
and continuing to hone each other going forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, only four representatives will be chosen for Japan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how deep the bond becomes.
No matter how well one understands the other's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even if you've grown attached to them,
don't bring that into the race.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...It is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Insolent rat.
Do you dare address Us without even stating your name?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who appeared before me,
Orfevre, looks over with a suspicious gaze.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We must have crossed paths several times as members of "Project L'Arc"... but I decided to properly introduce myself to her again.
choice_data_list: Sorry for suddenly talking to you earlier.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Enough. Know your place, human.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
And so. Fellow travelers to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
You too desire victory on that grand stage, do you not?
choice_data_list: Yeah, we're aiming for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe too.
Yeah, we're aiming for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I know full well how harsh this stage is.
Even so, I still want to
aim for the world together with <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With her, who chases this dream alongside me.
And above all else, seeing her strive hard each day—"
choice_data_list: (I want to let her stand on the world stage—!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Absurd. Don't hide your toes,
soaked in greed, behind the word 'aim'.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: My eyes see all.

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text:
"...Cleaning of the VR Umulator is finished~!
Next up, systems maintenance crew, please~!"

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
I secured our lodging!!
We can all stay at the same hotel without a hitch!

text_block_list.name: External Farrier
text_block_list.text: Should we make the horseshoes for the girl running right now 1mm thicker? I'll have the materials prepared on our end.

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text:
!! Are you sure?!
But as I mentioned the other day, the budget is...

text_block_list.name: External Farrier
text_block_list.text:
We have people we can turn to for help.
...Please, allow us to give it our all as well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What I desire is neither a 'commemoration' nor 'defeat.'
Only one thing—'Victory.'

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "For that reason, the pilgrims devote everything and pray. ...You, too, are one of them."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was momentarily lost for words.
"One of them" aiming for victory.
...As the true weight of those words sank in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This project involves not just Umamusume and Trainers,
but everyone who dreams of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
choice_data_list: (And supported by everyone who gathered here.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: All the efforts gathered here are dedicated to one thing: a "victory" for Japan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe isn't just our dream. It's the dream of everyone involved in this project."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Very well, very well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I shall grant it.
You too may offer everything—your wishes, your pain.
—All the dreams you have staked your lives upon.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: And so, celebrate the King's triumphant return.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre walks away, her hair fluttering in the breeze.
Her back is magnificent... and one can only wonder
how many hopes and wishes are resting upon her shoulders.
choice_data_list: （…That is the “duty” of those who race.）

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I instinctively straightened my back.
If I want to bring my trainee to the grandest stage in the world, I have to mold her into someone whose strength leaves no room for doubt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only a back that can carry all the dreams
of the people supporting them
can truly represent Japan.
